summary: TAP Real Estate Technologies filed an 8-K regarding an Option to Purchase Agreement with Wasatch Springs Management Holdings for the Zermatt Resort in Midway, Utah. The initial 60-day option was extended by 90 days to May 22, 2026. No price per share, premium, or implied value is disclosed; the filing is silent on consideration and board recommendation. The option is non-binding pending financing and operational due diligence. Watch for definitive purchase agreement terms, financing commitment, and regulatory approvals.
